title: Historical Sites
heading: Old places with a cracking story to tell
intro: Castles, grand houses, ruins and the places that make you wonder what life was like back then. UK historic attractions turn a day out into a bit of an adventure. Browse the guides and see which story catches your eye. Think about how much walking you fancy, check the current opening arrangements and leave time to explore properly. Add a food stop or a wander in the nearby town and you have the makings of a lovely day.
